title: Workspace Validation / Browser and Manual Smoke
goal: Validate the completed Phase 7 workspace foundation from PHASE7-IMPL-004 through PHASE7-IMPL-009 using automated regression checks, a prepared browser/manual smoke checklist, optional owner-observed UI notes, and roadmap/status closeout without adding runtime feature scope, generated prose, model calls, extraction, apply-promotion, or memory/canon mutation.
why_now: PHASE7-IMPL-004 through PHASE7-IMPL-009 are complete and committed. Browser/manual validation was intentionally deferred until this validation parent. The workspace now needs explicit acceptance before later extraction, apply-promotion, memory/canon mutation, or Dramatica work expands.

include: Validation of project creation, selection, switching, and blank-project compatibility.
Validation of OMI-guided staged creation shell behavior and candidate/setup label visibility.
Validation of Project Overview, shared editor save behavior, dirty-state/keyboard-save safeguards, and workspace view separation.
Validation of scene/chapter metadata compatibility and notes/materials listing/editing behavior.
Validation of Memory / Canon shell approved-only empty states and OMI candidate exclusion.
Automated regression confirmation via existing pytest and frontend source-contract tests.
Browser/manual smoke checklist preparation and later execution.
Owner-observed UI smoke notes and validation repair triage only when needed.
exclude: New runtime features unless a later validation repair child explicitly authorizes a tiny safe bug fix.
Generated prose, summaries, extraction, semantic search, Story Check auto-runs, model calls, or Ollama calls.
Apply-promotion, memory/canon mutation, OMI candidate promotion, backend approved-memory routes/helpers, or frontend approved-memory API helpers.
Metadata editing UI, note/material create/import/upload UI, training/JSONL/dataset work, or package/dependency changes.

quality_notes: T001 creates inventory, task record, enrichment JSON, and roadmap/status updates only.
Validation confirms completed workspace behavior from PHASE7-IMPL-004 through PHASE7-IMPL-009.
Browser/manual validation execution remains deferred until T004.

automated.notes: Primary frontend source-contract and regression surface for workspace views, editor, overview, staged creation, and memory/canon shell boundaries.
Project creation, metadata compatibility, notes/materials helpers, and OMI lifecycle safety.
Scene route compatibility and metadata behavior.
Note/material route compatibility and path safety.

manual.notes: Prepared in T003 and executed in T004; covers project creation/selection, workspace views, editor saves, overview, OMI labels, memory/canon shell, and absence of AI prose controls.
Recorded during browser/manual smoke without turning validation into feature expansion.

acceptance_criteria: Validation scope for PHASE7-IMPL-004 through PHASE7-IMPL-009 is documented before execution children run.
Automated regression suites pass or failures are recorded with triage classification.
Browser/manual smoke checklist exists before execution unless explicitly deferred with recorded rationale.
Browser/manual smoke results are recorded without turning validation into feature expansion.

No generated prose, summaries, extraction, semantic search, Story Check auto-runs, model/Ollama calls, apply-promotion, memory/canon mutation, training/JSONL/dataset changes, or new runtime feature scope are introduced by validation work.

validation.notes: T001 is docs/status only. Pytest, app servers, frontend builds, browser/manual validation, model calls, and Ollama calls are deferred to later children.

safety_notes: Validation confirms analysis-only boundaries; it does not weaken them.
Owner-authored prose storage and editing remain owner-controlled actions, not AI prose generation.
OMI candidates, promotion audit records, and staged setup data remain non-canon.
Approved Memory / Canon lists remain empty-state only until future apply-promotion exists.
Validation must not silently promote candidates, create memory/*.json, or mutate durable project truth except through explicit owner/test temp paths during smoke.
deferred_work: Validation repair until T005 and only if issues are found.
Extraction, semantic search, generated summaries, and Story Check auto-runs.
Metadata editing UI and note/material create/import/upload UI.
New runtime feature scope beyond tiny authorized validation repairs.
